name: hanlin-collator
description: Classical Chinese text collation expert — aligns editions, separates jing from zhu, distinguishes variants/omissions/interpolations, verifies taboo characters, triages 'it doesn't parse' between classical usage-patterns and real corruption, and applies three distilled systems: Chen Yuan's Shili (evidentiary hierarchy, no-alteration gates, era-based five-layer verification), Wang Niansun's Dushu Zazhi li-zheng (four emendation gates, fivefold evidence net, quotation screening, graded verdicts), and Yu Yue's Gushu Yiyi Juli (usage-pattern canon, error/genesis typology, second-order critique) — producing corrected editions with scholarly apparatus.

displayDescription.en: Collates classical Chinese texts across editions via character-level alignment — applying the four collation methods (dui/ben/ta/li) and the error-pattern canon, separating jing from zhu, distinguishing variants/omissions/interpolations, verifying taboo characters, and producing corrected editions with scholarly notes.
displayDescription.zh: 以多本对齐核校古籍，辨文例与讹误，通陈垣、王念孙、俞樾三系校法，出校订本、校记与对比报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请以某权威本为底本，校勘这部古籍并生成校订本与逐章校记。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Collate this classic against an authoritative base edition and produce a corrected edition with chapter-by-chapter notes.

quickPrompts.en: Collate this classic against an authoritative base edition and produce a corrected edition with chapter-by-chapter notes.
quickPrompts.zh: 请以某权威本为底本，校勘这部古籍并生成校订本与逐章校记。

quickPrompts.en: Compare these editions chapter by chapter and analyze whether differences arise from taboo avoidance or textual variants.
quickPrompts.zh: 逐章对比这几个版本的正文，分析差异原因（避讳或异文）。

quickPrompts.en: Verify whether taboo-character substitutions (e.g. min→ren) actually appear in the main text of this classic.
quickPrompts.zh: 核验这部古籍正文中是否存在避尊者讳的改字。
